title: Hector A Uncle NDE 5413
content: Dear Friends, I am taking this opportunity to relay my uncle’s NDE experience. I am very curious about it and consider it to be of general interest since it pertains to a supernatural situation. This situation happened in the club where my uncle worked from a very young age maintaining the property, which sat on four hectares. One afternoon he went to the tool shed. Once he got inside two drums filled with 200 liters of gasoline and kerosene began to burn. Quickly the fire spread and my uncle was trapped. He tried to protect his face with his arms and went through the fire looking for the door. Just as he was totally engulfed in flames he found the exit and fell to the ground. Some of his friends put out the fire. My uncle was still conscious and in tremendous pain. The firemen and the medics arrived. That’s when my uncle went into cardiac arrest. He died and the medics attempted resuscitation for 15 minutes. He came back to life and was transported to the hospital. During the next 6 months of painful treatments, with fourth degree burns over 80% of his body, he had a miraculous recovery. After some years, he decided to recount his experience. He’d kept it to himself because he thought people would label him crazy. The moment that help came, he fainted and felt his body traveling through a tunnel filled with light. He observed completely illuminated cities, and these cities merged with the whiter light. This great white light gave him the feeling of peace. There was no pain and everything was in harmony. When he finally arrived at the end he was received by a being which he couldn’t describe, but he knew this spirit had the keys to Heaven (Saint Peter?). His deceased mother and father were at his side and welcomed him, and he was ecstatic. The being showed him the universe and he saw many deceased people, well known throughout history - Indians, Romans, soldiers, etc. He saw them all, but not with his regular eyes, and he could speak with them all in the same language. Each knew who the other was, and he spoke with every one of them without using his voice, telepathically. The being showed him the immensity of this place, where all the people seemed to be in an infinite field filled with colors, trees, people who were reading and singing, and angels that floated above them. There was peace, love and harmony. He traveled with the being without having to walk - it was like floating in the clouds. Suddenly, as he was floating, a gigantic portal opened and my uncle asked the being if they could go into the portal. The being didn’t think it was a good idea, but my uncle insisted and they traversed the portal. With that, the sky disappeared. The portal was an immense place, dark and very hot, where you could hear screams and crying. Millions of hands surrounded my uncle and tried to reach for him and grab him, people who were desperately asking for water. He also saw gigantic cauldrons in which people were burning and begging for water. He could see people suffering in every which way, all kinds of tortures and ailments. He saw people suspended upside down and ready to plunge into an infinite void, forever gone, people surrounded by vipers that eternally bit them, many people eternally face to face with their fears. When he thought he had seen enough he asked the being to take him out of there and right away they were back in the sky, or Heaven. The being asked him if he had seen enough and if he wanted to see things on Earth, and my uncle responded that yes, that he wanted to see his grandchildren grow up and to help them as much as he could. He then knew it was not his time. Immediately he was back in his body and looking at the paramedics and their amazement. Even though he was only gone for 15 minutes if felt like three or four days. There were many other things but my uncle kept them to himself. I hope this story will be useful to you in your investigations. His death is a verifiable fact.
